memeqa.annotation_provenance: human interpretation paragraphs, automatically constructed/adversarially filtered distractors, independent human answer verification; ACL paper section 3.4
memeqa.split_policy: native meme-level train/dev/test; None-minus single-answer only
memeqa.license: annotation repository MIT; original SemEval images free for general research use; original meme copyright remains separate

met-meme.annotation_provenance: manual labels per original publisher; fidelity of the Hub labels to unretrieved original annotation sheets is not independently verified
met-meme.split_policy: English rows from Hub-provided 60/20/20 partitions; test then validation then train precedence for exact image duplicates; conflicting image-label vectors excluded
met-meme.license: Original Kaggle distribution explicitly Unknown; Hub card unspecified

memeqa.assessment: Obama/Biden vote-record meme matches native accusation of voter fraud; needs political background and has near-synonymous distractor voting irregularities, so this is a qualified example, not proof of unambiguous supervision.
Text explicitly calls Trump one of the greatest; native praises gold matches.
Text explicitly criticizes Democrats screaming racial slurs at Black police; demeaning gold matches.

met-meme.assessment: Cat jumping, invisible pogo stick joke: entertaining, non-offensive, literal reference without a source-target metaphor; happiness is a plausible broad positive tone.
Jim Carrey surprise at romantic attention: entertaining and non-offensive, no explicit source-target metaphor; happiness label is broad rather than a precise emotion description.

Penguin meme complains about penguin memes: entertaining/non-offensive, literal; hate label expresses dislike/annoyance and is stronger than the displayed sentiment. Retained as native subjective supervision, not objective fact.

limitations: Coarse image review only, three source images each; not an audit of all rows.
Emotion and offensiveness are subjective; native labels are not relabeled by the reviewing model.
Exact image checks do not detect all template-level or near-duplicate leakage.
